title: Frésko
line: The hackathon idea that became StillGood.
problem: Food waste often starts with forgetting what's in the fridge.
did: With my team, I designed an app that tracks expiry dates, reads grocery receipts, sends reminders and suggests recipes.
outcome: We reached the grand finals of the SP Batey Hackathon 2024.

story.title: The idea
story.body: Food waste often starts with forgetting what's in the fridge. At the SP Batey Hackathon in September 2024, my team, Zenith Technologies, set out to fix that.

story.title: What we designed
story.body: We designed Frésko in Figma: an app that tracks expiry dates, reads grocery receipts to add items for you, sends reminders before food goes off, and suggests recipes to use it up.

story.title: What happened next
story.body: Frésko reached the grand finals. The idea stayed with me, and in 2026 I built it for real as StillGood, now on the Google Play Store.
story.callout: The hackathon design became the starting point for StillGood.
